title: Show queue loading screen during source scan
summary: Make the WebView Queue page hide the currently rendered queue rows behind a loading screen while Scan Sources is submitting and refreshing the backend queue snapshot.
reason: The previous queue table stayed visible during a dry-run source scan, so the operator could miss that the displayed rows were stale until the refreshed queue arrived.
behavior_before: Clicking Scan Sources updated the button, topbar, and inventory status but left the previous queue table visible until the refreshed backend payload rendered.
behavior_after: Clicking Scan Sources immediately replaces the queue table area with a loading screen and clears stale table status until renderQueue receives and displays the refreshed backend queue payload.
